show.description: Rudhra thinks his life is under control until his wife Trisha starts hiding the truth. What looks like a normal marriage slowly turns into a dangerous game of lies and betrayal. As Rudhra gets closer to the truth, every step puts him in more trouble. In the end, the real question is not what Trisha did, but how far Rudhra will go once he finds out.
